meta.name: Dont Look Deeper
meta.description:
In near-future California, high school senior Aisha learns a dark secret about herself. She goes from dreams of graduation and college...to suddenly running for her life.

Rated TV-MA · Ended · First aired 27 Jul 2020 · United States of America · Language: English · 10 min
Studio: 30 Ninjas, New Form Digital · Network: Quibi

Complete series. On your server: S1 14/14

On your server — Audio: English

videos.title: Alpha
videos.overview: When what should be a typical day turns into a nightmare...Aisha heads to a party to try and unwind, only to discover an unsettling secret about who she really is.

videos.title: Panic
videos.overview: As Aisha attempts to come to terms with the revelation about who she really is, her friends and classmates become suspicious of her behavior. Terrified and confused, she discovers an ally, who may be able to provide some answers.

videos.title: Reset
videos.overview: Aisha wakes up in her bed to discover that her life appears to be back to normal. Is it possible that everything she's learned...was a dream? With her head spinning out of control, Aisha tries to tease apart reality from nightmare.

videos.title: Jailbreak
videos.overview: Rylium CEO Noah is informed of an intimacy breach with one of their "emBeds", and decides to send his brother Abel to take care of it. Meanwhile, Aisha seeks Levi's help to test the limits of what she's capable of.

videos.title: Testing
videos.overview: Rylium sends Abel to retrieve their faulty "emBed". Aisha tests Martin to try and find out what he knows. An overwhelmed Martin consults Sharon about a "plan B".

videos.title: Source
videos.overview: Set in the past, Martin meets Sharon and Aisha for the first time. Martin doesn't know Aisha's secret, and Sharon doesn't mention anything... until Aisha has an emotional breakdown that forces the truth to come out.

videos.title: Artifacts
videos.overview: Aisha finally confronts Martin about her "birth". She learns why her existence must be kept a secret, and what would happen if she were discovered. Aisha formulates a plan to win her freedom.

videos.title: Beta
videos.overview: Aisha finds a new sense of freedom and rebellion now that nobody's tracking her. That is, until Abel arrives to deal with the faulty emBed.

videos.title: Offline
videos.overview: Abel wastes no time tracking Aisha. Jenny reveals that there's still more that Aisha doesn't know about her past. Aisha and Jenny seek Levi's help to embark on a mission.

videos.title: Connect
videos.overview: Abel confronts Sharon about Aisha's whereabouts. Aisha begins to have doubts about her mission. Jenny and Aisha's bond grows stronger, and Jenny agrees to help Aisha regain lost memories.

videos.title: Revert
videos.overview: Jenny hacks Aisha, unlocking memories that had previously been wiped. Aisha remembers the true story of her past connection with Jenny, and why Martin and Sharon kept it from her.

videos.title: Drive
videos.overview: A freaked out Aisha disappears when she recalls troubling memories. Aisha learns more about what she left behind at Rylium. Jenny catches Levi up on the truth about Aisha, as they frantically search for her.

videos.title: Execute
videos.overview: Abel transports Aisha back to Rylium's headquarters. Martin, Sharon and Noah argue over what Aisha's ultimate fate should be.

videos.title: Loophole
videos.overview: Aisha and Calian meet their fate. Martin and Sharon try to deal with the fallout, and Jenny tries to understand a cryptic message Aisha left behind.
